chapters.title: How withholding taxes work - workflow example
Demo - purchase invoice posting and calculations

features.name: Withholding Tax for Vendors and Purchase Process
features.description: New capability to apply withholding taxes to vendors during the purchase process. Withholding tax is deducted at source from payments before the recipient receives the net amount, based on configured percentages and thresholds.
caveats: Currently only covers vendors and purchase process, not employees or customers
Not available in Australia, New Zealand, India, and Italy
Available globally except these four countries

features.name: Withholding Tax Posting Groups Configuration
features.description: Configuration model using withholding tax business posting groups and product posting groups, similar to VAT setup. Includes withholding tax posting setup with threshold rules, revenue types, and sequences to support multiple withholding taxes for the same vendor.
caveats: Requires completion of setup fields before posting is allowed

features.name: Vendor Withholding Tax Enablement
features.description: Vendors can be configured with withholding tax liability through the Invoicing tab by enabling the withholding tax liable field and assigning a withholding tax business posting group. System blocks posting if withholding tax liable is enabled but posting group is not populated.
caveats: System enforces validation - posting blocked without complete setup

features.name: Item Withholding Tax Product Posting Group
features.description: Items can be configured with withholding tax product posting groups to determine withholding tax calculation behavior at the item level, independent of vendor configuration.

features.name: Withholding Tax Threshold and Calculation Rules
features.description: Support for multiple calculation rule types including less than, less than or equal, equal, greater than, and greater than or equal thresholds. Each rule can have its own withholding tax percentage, and multiple sequential rules can be applied to the same vendor.
caveats: Sequences allow multiple withholding taxes to be calculated in order

features.name: Invoice vs Payment Withholding Tax Timing
features.description: Withholding tax can be realized on invoice or unrealized on payment. Configuration allows choosing when withholding tax is calculated and recorded - either when the invoice is created or when payment is made.
caveats: Payment-based withholding shows as unrealized until payment is made

features.name: Withholding Tax Base Override
features.description: Field to override the withholding tax calculation base amount. Allows using a different base amount than the invoice amount for withholding tax calculation purposes.
caveats: Does not change the invoice amount, only the calculation base

features.name: Withholding Tax Posting Preview
features.description: Preview posting functionality shows withholding tax entries before posting, including base amounts and withholding tax amounts for both realized and unrealized scenarios.

features.name: Withholding Tax Entries Tracking
features.description: New withholding tax entries are created during posting that track the withholding tax amount, base amount, and status (realized or unrealized). Entries can be found and reviewed after posting.
caveats: Unrealized entries convert to realized when payment is made

features.name: General Ledger Setup Requirement
features.description: Withholding tax must be enabled in General Ledger Setup, and minimum withholding tax amount must be configured before the feature can be used. Payment rounding option is also available.
caveats: Feature is disabled by default and requires explicit enablement

features.name: Withholding Tax for Australia and New Zealand
features.description: Withholding tax functionality is currently unavailable in Australia and New Zealand due to existing local withholding tax implementations. Future release will provide upgrade path via feature management to migrate to the new global model with localizations.
caveats: Not available in current release for Australia and New Zealand
Upgrade path coming in next release
Will maintain same functionality level as current localizations

features.name: Withholding Tax for India and Italy
features.description: Withholding tax functionality is not available in India and Italy in this release. These countries have different withholding tax models that require separate research and implementation.
features.status_evidence_quote: In Italy we have completely different withholding tax. So it will be subject of research what we need to do how we can and
caveats: Not available for these countries in current release
